meaning:
ἐν-ισχύω
[in LXX for חָזַק, etc. ;]
to strengthen: in spiritual sense, Luk.22:43; pass., Act.9:19 (Rec. ἐνισχύσεν, became strong, as in LXX, Gen.12:10 48:2, al.).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: An angel from heaven appeared to him, strengthening him.
He took food and was strengthened. Saul stayed several days with the disciples who were at Damascus.
